model.title: Model
model.description: The completion model name, e.g. gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct or a base model your proxy routes.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Optional. Maximum number of tokens to generate.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Optional. 0 = focused and deterministic, higher = more creative. Leave blank for the model default.

stop.title: Stop
stop.description: Optional. One or more strings that, when produced, stop generation.
